entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this garbage jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your order number?
I don't have it handy! Just look up my name, John Smith. This shouldn't be this difficult. I want to return a jersey because it's the wrong size. It's way too tight to even ride in.

Okay, I understand. I've found your account, Mr. Smith. I see the order for the Pro-Series jersey. Can you tell me, is there a technical fault with it, or is it a matter of preference with the sizing?

What do you mean 'preference'? Your sizing chart is a joke! I ordered a large, which I always am, and this thing is skin-tight. I can't even breathe in it! I need to exchange it or get my money back, now.
I completely understand your frustration with the sizing. Let me just check the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 78 days ago. Let me review our policy for you.

78 days, 10 days, who cares? Your website says 10 days! Don't try to weasel out of this. If you don't approve this, I want your manager's name and I'm plastering this experience all over your social media.

There's no need for that, sir. You are absolutely correct. Our policy for apparel like this jersey is indeed a 10-day return window. Since you're at 78 days, you are unfortunately outside that timeframe.
So you're going to process it then? No more games?
Yes, of course. I can definitely help you with this. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to process an exchange for the next size up?
Fine. An exchange. But if the next one is also the wrong size, I'm just getting my money back.

Understood. I've just initiated the exchange for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack up the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. We'll ship the new one out as soon as the return is scanned. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's it. Just make sure it gets done right this time.
It will be. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
